sharedRules.name: Cult Ambush
sharedRules.description:
If your Army Faction is GENESTEALER CULTS, you gain 6/10/14 Resurgence points (Incursion/Strike Force/Onslaught).
Each time a friendly unit is destroyed, if every model in that unit (excluding CHARACTER models) has the Cult Ambush ability, you can use this ability:
  - Spend the Resurgence points the cost table gives for the datasheet and Starting Strength of that unit (Aberrants: 4 for 5 models, 8 for 10 models; Acolyte Hybrids with Autopistols, Acolyte Hybrids with Hand Flamers or Hybrid Metamorphs: 2 for 5 models, 4 for 10 models; Atalan Jackals: 2 for 5 models, 6 for 10 models; Neophyte Hybrids: 3 for 10 models, 6 for 20 models; Purestrain Genestealers: 2 for 5 models, 6 for 10 models).
  - Add a new unit identical to that unit (excluding CHARACTER models) to your army in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength and with all of its wounds remaining, with its [ONE SHOT] weapons counted as not having been shot.
  - Place a cult ambush marker (32mm) more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units.
If your Army Faction is GENESTEALER CULTS:
  - Friendly units that are in Cult Ambush cannot be targeted with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem.
  - Friendly units that are in Cult Ambush are not destroyed for still being in Strategic Reserves at the end of the third battle round.
Each time an enemy model (excluding AIRCRAFT models) ends a move, if your Army Faction is GENESTEALER CULTS, while the triggering model is within 8" of a cult ambush marker, remove that cult ambush marker from the battlefield.
At the end of your opponent's Movement phase, you can use this ability: if your Army Faction is GENESTEALER CULTS, select any number of friendly units that are in Cult Ambush (at most the number of your cult ambush markers on the battlefield); those units can make an Ingress move; those units can be set up on the battlefield using a Cult Ambush marker, wholly within 3" of that marker, even in the first battle round.

rules.description:

rules.name: Psionic Parasitism
rules.description:
At the end of your Movement phase, until the start of your next Movement phase:
  For each friendly SYNAPSE TYRANIDS unit:
    - You can:
      - Select one friendly GENESTEALER CULTS unit (excluding PATRIARCH or PURESTRAIN GENESTEALERS units) that is within 9" of this unit and visible to this unit (referred to below as the cult):
        - Select one friendly TYRANIDS unit that is within 9" of this unit and visible to this unit (referred to below as the brood):
          - Roll D3+1, then:
            - The chosen cult suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result of that roll.
            - One model in the chosen brood regains up to a number of lost wounds equal to the result of that roll.
          - Add 1 to the chosen brood's Hit rolls.
Friendly TYRANIDS units gain the Catalyst ability:
  - While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit, if the attack targets that unit, add 1 to friendly GENESTEALER CULTS units' Hit rolls.
